name: Zed
summary: Open-source code editor written in Rust, with real-time collaboration and built-in AI agents.
description: Zed is a code editor written from scratch in Rust by the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter, available for macOS, Linux and Windows. It supports real-time collaboration and runs AI agents, including external ones such as Claude Agent and Codex CLI. The Personal plan is free and works with the user's own API keys. Pro costs $10 per month with edit predictions and $5 of included tokens; Business is $30 per seat per month.
